questions.question_text: Muktanand Swami kirtan pramāṇe, sādhu mān apamānme _______ ane sukhduḥkhme _______ rākhe chhe.
questions.explanation: According to Muktanand Swami's kirtan (tankī 1): 'Mān apamānme ekatā, sukhduḥkhme samabhāv'.

questions.question_text: Muktanand Swami kirtan pramāṇe, sādhu nārīne _______ taje.
questions.explanation: According to Muktanand Swami's kirtan (tankī 2): 'Nārī nāgaṇī sam taje'.

questions.question_text: Muktanand Swami kirtan pramāṇe, je mamatā karī maṭh na bāndhe, shaṭhatā kīnī _______ ane kabahu krodh na upaje, te sāchā vairāgya chhe.
questions.explanation: According to Muktanand Swami's kirtan (tankī 3): 'Maṭh na bāndhe mamatā karī, shaṭhatā kīnī tyāg; Kabahu krodh na upaje, so sāchā vairāgya'.

questions.question_text: Muktanand Swami kirtan pramāṇe, eva sant sadā konī pās rahat?
questions.explanation: According to Muktanand Swami's kirtan (tankī 4): 'Muktānand so santke, sadā rahat hari pās'.

questions.question_text: Premanand Swami kirtan pramāṇe (Evā santnī balihārī), evā sant manmā _______ na āṇe ane _______ te sam karī jāṇe.
options: Kām, krodh, lobh; Sonu ne dhūḷ
questions.correct_answer: Kām, krodh, lobh; Sonu ne dhūḷ
questions.explanation: According to Premanand Swami's kirtan (evā 1): 'Kām, krodh, lobh manmā na āṇe, Sonu ne dhūḷ te sam karī jāṇe'.
questions.source_reference: Kirtan - Premanand Swami (Evā santnī balihārī), evā 1

questions.question_text: Premanand Swami kirtan pramāṇe (Evā santnī balihārī), eva santne Lobh laharno _______ na lāge.
questions.explanation: According to Premanand Swami's kirtan (evā 2): 'Lobh laharno lesh na lāge'.
questions.source_reference: Kirtan - Premanand Swami (Evā santnī balihārī), evā 2

questions.question_text: Premanand Swami kirtan pramāṇe (Evā santnī balihārī), jeṇe Brahmavidyā dṛuḍh karī sādhī ane Pinḍ brahmāṇḍnī upādhi tajī, te _______ hitkārī hoy.
questions.explanation: According to Premanand Swami's kirtan (evā 3): 'Brahmavidyā jeṇe dṛuḍh karī sādhī, Pinḍ brahmāṇḍnī tajī re upādhi; Hā re bhūtprāṇī taṇā hitkārī re'.
questions.source_reference: Kirtan - Premanand Swami (Evā santnī balihārī), evā 3

questions.question_text: Bhaktichintamani.76/39 pramāṇe, sukh duḥkh āve sarve bheḷu, temā _______ rākhjyo.
questions.explanation: According to Bhaktichintamani.76/39: 'Sukh duḥkh āve sarve bheḷu, temā rākhjyo sthir mati'.

questions.question_text: Bhaktichintamani.76/40 pramāṇe, jo vrat ṭek ṭāḷsho to shu bhogavsho?
questions.explanation: According to Bhaktichintamani.76/40: 'Paṇ vrat ṭek jo ṭāḷsho to, bhogavsho sahu sahu taṇu'.

questions.question_text: Vachanamrut Ga.An.2 pramāṇe, jene parampad kahīe ane moksh kahīe tene _______ pāmyo chhe.
questions.explanation: According to Vachanamrut Ga.An.2: 'Māṭe jene parampad kahīe, moksh kahīe tene chhate dehe ja pāmyo chhe'.
